parts.reason: This value (Σbm) is calculated solely as an intermediate step toward computing S_bm and then the PMCC using the formula; since S5.1/S2.2 explicitly exclude calculation of correlation coefficients using the formula, this preparatory calculation is part of the excluded process.

parts.label: b
parts.reason: S_bm is calculated specifically to substitute into the PMCC formula; S5.1 states 'use of the formula is not required' and calculation of correlation coefficients is excluded, so this step toward the excluded formula-based calculation is out.

parts.label: c
parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly excludes calculation of correlation coefficients using the formula; here r is computed via S_bm/√(S_bb·S_mm), the formula method, which is excluded even though calculator-based r is allowed elsewhere.
